text:
Lina Park: Quick sync — launching the LLM inference post + webinar on Apr 7. Need a compact SEO/tactical checklist we can execute in sprint: keyword targets, schema JSON-LD, internal links from docs & benchmark blog, and redirect rules for renamed pages. Assignments?
Ravi Shah: I'll own keyword mapping and meta/title templates. Plan: one primary phrase + two supporting long-tails per page. Will add search intent notes and example metas. Deliverable: shared sheet by Thu.
Dana Ruiz: I'll produce JSON-LD for WebinarEvent + FAQPage and a VideoObject snippet for the replay. Will validate with Rich Results and paste screenshots.
Omar Hassan: Redirects are my area — there are five old docs that now live under /docs/platform. I'll prepare a CSV and NGINX + Netlify redirect examples. Suggest testing via 302 then flip to 301.
Nate Brooks: GTM + forms: need hidden fields for campaign attribution and a conversion event. Propose hidden field `campaign=llm_launch_apr2026`, GTM event `webinar_signup`. Also wire registration -> SFDC lead owner mapping.
Lina Park: Good. @Ravi include UTM param examples (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) in the sheet. @Dana please include sample FAQ Q/A that mirrors landing page copy for consistent snippets.
Ravi Shah: Initial keyword picks: landing page primary: "low-latency LLM inference"; support: "LLM inference optimization", "production LLM serving". Webinar page primaries: "LLM inference webinar", long-tail: "reduce inference latency cost", "inference caching strategies".
Dana Ruiz: Draft JSON-LD for webinar (staging only): ```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Running LLMs at Scale: latency, cost, and reliability",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T16:00:00Z",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/llm-inference"},
  "performer": {"@type": "Person", "name": "Redwood Engineers"},
  "offers": {"@type": "Offer", "url": "https://redwood.ai/register"}
}
```
Omar Hassan: Sample NGINX redirect rule for one doc: ```
# temporary redirect for testing
rewrite ^/docs/serve-old-model/?$ /docs/platform/serving-models/ permanent;
```
Nate Brooks: On form mapping, SalesOps wants `lead_source` = campaign value and `utm_content` passed when traffic originates from the benchmarks blog. I'll add dataLayer examples for GTM.
Lina Park: Owners & deadlines: Ravi -> keywords + meta templates by Thu (1752040000). Dana -> JSON-LD + test screenshots by Mon (1752172800). Omar -> redirect CSV + PR by Fri EOD (1752120000). Nate -> GTM + form spec by Mon (1752172800). I'll schedule a 20m review after assets are in.
seo-bot: Action item: after schema is on staging, run Structured Data Testing Tool and Lighthouse; post results here.
Ravi Shah: Internal linking plan: add contextual links from /docs/overview, /docs/performance, and 2 benchmark blog posts. I'll include anchor text suggestions and target URLs in the sheet.
Dana Ruiz: QA list: structured data validator pass, Rich Results preview, SERP title/snippet mockup, and accessibility check for webinar page.
Omar Hassan: I'll stage redirects as 302s in the PR and include curl checks for HTTP status codes.
Nate Brooks: Also adding GTM trigger: fire conversion when form submission + dataLayer.campaign == 'llm_launch_apr2026'.
Lina Park: Perfect — thanks team. I'll update Asana and attach the sheet + PR links once available. Ping here if you need scope changes. :sparkles:
